events.text: Since the clear-sky thunder, birds fly around your house and never over it. A fortune-teller in the market refuses your coin and tells you, quietly, to stop doing whatever you are doing.

ok.log: 'Nothing,' she says. 'That is the trouble. It only watches.'

fail.log: The fortune-teller says nothing at all, and the birds that followed you home say the rest. Your luck sours for a season.

effects.log: The birds keep circling. You get used to it.

events.text: Lightning strikes your old training post every year on the same night. This year you are standing beside it, and the bolt hangs in the air for a breath, as if deciding.

ok.log: It goes through you and out into the ground and something in your channels is wider afterwards.

fail.log: The bolt takes you instead of the post. You wake in a ditch with your hair standing on end, alive for reasons nobody can name.

effects.log: The bolt falls on the post. You bow again, to be safe.

events.text: A Taoist from the far mountains walks a month to see you, looks at you for exactly one breath, and says that heaven has a ledger and your page is getting very full.

effects.log: 'Kindness,' he says, 'and fewer miracles.' He walks back the way he came.

choices.text: Ask how to fill it faster

effects.log: He laughs for a long time, then tells you, and walks back very fast.

events.text: A drought falls on your province alone, and the priests say a person who has defied heaven lives here. Everyone knows who they mean. The rain stays on the borders, watching.

choices.text: Climb the mountain and speak to the sky

ok.log: You shout at heaven for a day. Heaven answers with rain, as a parent answers a child: not because you are right, but because you are loud.

fail.deathCause: a mountain in a drought heaven sent
fail.log: You shout until your voice breaks and heaven only watches. You are carried down the mountain half-dead from thirst.

choices.text: Leave the province so the rain comes

effects.log: You are a day past the border when the first rain falls behind you.

events.text: A heavenly envoy in white comes down a ray of light and offers you a choice: give up the cultivation road and heaven will forget you, or walk on and be tested again.

ok.log: The envoy tests you with a single sword stroke. You stand. The envoy goes back up the light and the sky is quiet for a decade.

fail.log: The envoy's single stroke puts you on your back. It looks down at you for a long moment, and goes back up the light without finishing it.

choices.text: Ask the envoy to sit and talk

ok.log: The envoy sits. It has never been asked. It tells you heaven is lonely, and leaves with a cup of your tea.

fail.log: The envoy does not sit. It takes the offered cup as an insult and leaves a scorch across the table, and across your hand.

events.text: Heaven's last trial wears the face of someone you loved who is dead, and asks you to come with them, now, and stop all this.

ok.log: It cries, then it smiles, then it is only light. Heaven has tested you three times and you are still here.

fail.deathCause: a trial that wore a beloved face
fail.log: You hesitate, and the face almost has you. You tear free at the last step, shaking, and heaven lets you go this once.

effects.log: It is the face, not the person. You hold it anyway. Heaven, embarrassed, does not try that again.

events.text: For three nights the stars did not move. Now two of them do: a red star toward your house, a white star away. The astrologers of the court argue over which is you.

effects.log: It leads you to a mountain temple that has been expecting you for a century. They have kept your room.
It leads you to a battlefield that has not happened yet, and you walk it, and learn every step of it.

events.text: The sky over your head is clear in a storm and stormy in a calm. The murim understands: heaven has stopped hiding that it is personally interested in you. Some sects want you dead for it. Some want to worship you.

effects.log: A temple with your face on the altar. It makes you uneasy, and very well-fed.

choices.text: Go into seclusion until it passes

effects.log: Ten years in a cave. When you come out, the sky has forgotten its grudge and remembered only that it liked you.

events.text: A rainbow touches the ground at your feet and stays there. It is a bridge. On the far side, very small, a gate. Heaven is inviting you, early, to see what it has been deciding.

ok.log: On the other side, someone at a desk with a ledger looks up, surprised, and closes your page. You walk back with the rest of your life unwritten.

fail.log: The bridge is only light, and light does not hold. You fall a long way and wake at its foot, alive, with the rainbow already fading.

choices.text: Bow and stay on the ground

effects.log: The rainbow lingers, then fades with something like respect. You will get there on your own feet.
